title: Results of the fifth population census in the Kingdom of the Netherlands, December 1869
descriptions: The dataset is based on the population census of the Netherlands of 1869 published in 3 vols. Content: images of the publication, searchable pdf files of the text sections and excel files with data entered from the published tables.
